name: Eggs with Spinach à la Martin
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: red pepper cut in strips
ingredients.originalText: 1 tablespoon red pepper cut in strips

ingredients.name: green pepper cut in strips
ingredients.originalText: 1 tablespoon green pepper cut in strips

ingredients.name: cooked ham cut in very small pieces
ingredients.originalText: 1 tablespoon cooked ham cut in very small pieces

instructions.text: Cover the centre of a platter with finely chopped and seasoned cooked spinach.
Beat three eggs slightly, add three tablespoons hot water, one-third teaspoon salt, one tablespoon, each, red and green pepper cut in strips, and one tablespoon cooked ham cut in very small pieces.
Heat omelet pan, put in one and one-half tablespoons olive oil, and as soon as heated pour in mixture.
Cook same as French Omelet and turn on to spinach.

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cover the centre of a platter with finely chopped and seasoned cooked spinach.
2. Beat three eggs slightly, add three tablespoons hot water, one-third teaspoon salt, one tablespoon, each, red and green pepper cut in strips, and one tablespoon cooked ham cut in very small pieces.
3. Heat omelet pan, put in one and one-half tablespoons olive oil, and as soon as heated pour in mixture.
4. Cook same as French Omelet and turn on to spinach.
5. Garnish with parsley.
